description: Phrases à trous du document audio « Rethinking the UN » + compréhension : P5, veto, organes de l'ONU.

questions.question: The UN pledged to save ___ generations from the scourge of war.
The former Secretary-General said the UN was there to save humankind from ___.
It was set up in ___.
The UN gathers ___ nations.
It has ___ main bodies.
Its main bodies include the Security ___, the General Assembly and the International Court of Justice.
Its main bodies include the Security Council, the General ___ and the International Court of Justice.
One of the most important agencies is the World ___ Programme.
The World Food Programme provides ___ for millions of people.
The Security Council lies at the ___ of the system.
The council is made up of five ___ members.
The five permanent members have ___ power: they can block any decision they want.
The US ___ Kuwait's resolution that condemned Israel's use of force against Palestinian civilians in Gaza.
Russia, Bashar al-Assad's ally, used the veto ___ times to block action against his regime.
Unlike the P5, the Security Council's ten non-permanent members don't have veto ___.
Among the P5 there are no countries from Africa and Latin ___.
The P5 are the countries that won the Second World ___.
Which Secretary-General said the UN was not created to take mankind to heaven, but to save humanity from hell?
What are the six main bodies (organs) of the UN? (plusieurs réponses)
questions.explication: Le PAM est une agence/programme, pas un organe principal ; l'OTAN n'a rien à voir avec l'ONU.

questions.question: Why does the audio say the veto is « like a poison »?
choix: because it gives too much power to small countries
because it is used by the General Assembly
because one permanent member can block any decision, which paralyses the Security Council
because it costs too much money
questions.explication: Le veto permet à un seul P5 de tout bloquer.

questions.question: Can non-permanent members be re-elected immediately?
choix: Yes, as many times as they want
Only if they get a veto
No, they can't be elected two years in a row (consecutive terms)
questions.explication: Article 23 de la Charte : pas de réélection immédiate.

questions.question: Which continents have no permanent member?
questions.explication: Critique fréquente : le Conseil ne reflète pas le monde d'aujourd'hui.

questions.question: Why are the P5 the P5?
choix: they are the most populated countries
they were the main victors of the Second World War
they pay the whole UN budget

questions.question: Why is the UN especially important?
choix: for smaller and poorer countries, which have a voice they would not have otherwise
questions.explication: Chaque État, même petit, a une voix à l'Assemblée générale.
